purpose: Add one mechanically exact population invariant to immutable v5 before support arithmetic; no chemistry, threshold, schema, firewall, or authority changes.

resolution.algorithm: Strictly parse the exact parent after receipt verification, resolve the RFC 6901 parent_object_pointer, require the member to be absent, add exactly the declared member/value pair, and reject any other operation or mutation.

operations.value: All valid union structural pair rows, with each transformation_pair_id counted exactly once regardless of local/episode overlap, endpoint eligibility, direction, or episode repetition.

resolution.effective_contract: The verified v5 parent plus the two ordered absent-member additions above; v5 remains immutable history and every unmentioned byte-level semantic is unchanged.
resolution.failure: Missing or changed parent bytes, a missing/non-object pointer target, a preexisting member, an unknown operation, or any additional mutation is a contract-integrity failure before support arithmetic.
